sectionsUsed: What is grid layout?, The grid container, Grid tracks: display grid creates a grid container; grid-template-columns defines column tracks; the fr unit represents a fraction of the available space; repeat() notation; minmax(). Page claims: teach step 2, track builder, GIFT o1.

1 Introduction: unlike Flexible Box Layout, which is single-axis oriented, Grid Layout is optimized for 2-dimensional layouts in which alignment of content is desired in both dimensions. Page claims: teach step 4, Grid or Flexbox sorter, apply question, GIFT o3.
7.2.4 Flexible Lengths, the fr unit: flex factors take a share of the leftover space; 1fr 2fr take one third and two thirds. Page claims: prediction, teach step 2.

7.2.1 Track Sizes, minmax(min, max): a size range at least min and at most max; 7.2.3.2 Repeat-to-fill, auto-fill: repeats the track as many times as fit without overflowing. Page claims: goal 3 checked at 300px and 200px, GIFT o1 minmax and auto-fill.

7.3 Named Areas, grid-template-areas: one string per row, one token per cell, the dot as a null cell token; if a named area's cells do not form a single filled-in rectangle the declaration is invalid. 8.4 grid-area: places an item in a named area. Page claims: teach step 3, area map, rejected L-shape, GIFT o2.
